dimensions.name: Correctness
dimensions.description: Produces a correct and internally consistent ai-infrastructure outcome.

dimensions.name: Trade-off reasoning
dimensions.description: Explains why the selected approach fits the stated constraints.
evidence_required: comparison against at least one alternative

dimensions.name: Reliability and safety
dimensions.description: Handles failure, recovery, security, and operational risk.
strong_indicators: bounded failure modes and recovery objectives

dimensions.name: Communication
dimensions.description: Presents assumptions, decisions, and validation clearly.

score_bands.90-100: Complete, correct, explicitly validated, and production-aware.
score_bands.75-89: Correct core answer with small scale or operational gaps.
score_bands.60-74: Partially correct but missing material constraints or evidence.
score_bands.0-59: Unsafe, incomplete, or unable to satisfy the core requirements.
